answer: Behavior-fingerprint escrow blocks fake identities. Each applicant locks 60 credits for 20 epochs and files a fingerprint of timing and counterparties, like a pigment sample. A newcomer matching an old fingerprint, or hiding under thin marble, stays locked and earns nothing. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 credits for no reward. An honest agent pays once, unlocks after 20 epochs, and keeps undiluted rewards, like nectar from one flower.
